Android controls which apps are set as your defaults. When you change a default, Android shows its own confirmation screen.

Some changes require Android's system interface — this is by design to protect your preferences.

Defaulty helps you view and manage your defaults, but the actual changes are always handled securely by Android itself.

Defaulty is 100%% offline. It doesn't collect, store, or transmit any personal data.

No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No network access.

All information is read directly from Android's built-in APIs and stays on your device.

Defaulty uses the following open-source libraries:

• Jetpack Compose — Apache License 2.0
• Material 3 — Apache License 2.0
• AndroidX Navigation — Apache License 2.0
• AndroidX DataStore — Apache License 2.0
• AndroidX Core SplashScreen — Apache License 2.0
A simple utility for viewing and managing your Android default applications.

Android controls which apps handle things like web browsing, phone calls, and messages.\n\nWhen you change a default, Android will show its own confirmation screen. This is normal — it\'s how Android keeps your choices secure.
Select your preferred theme. You can always change this later in Settings.
Tap below to start managing your default apps.
